description: This file defines an in-memory authentication session singleton object for demo or mock purposes within a web app. It includes methods for checking sign-in status, retrieving the current user, signing in as a demo user, and signing out.

classes.name: AuthSession
classes.description: Singleton object managing a mock authentication session, including user sign-in and sign-out operations.

methods.name: isSignedIn
methods.description: Checks if a user is currently signed in.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Retrieves the current signed-in user, if any.

methods.name: signInAsDemo
methods.description: Signs in a demo user with a specified email and returns the User object.

methods.name: signOut
methods.description: Signs out the current user, clearing the session.

calls: User(id = "u_demo", name = "Demo Admin", email = email.ifBlank { "demo@nmsi.org" }, roles = listOf("ADMIN", "FINANCE", "COORDINATOR"))
